info.title: ucgeocoder
info.description: Caching, rate-limited, wire-compatible proxy for the US Census Geocoder API

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The last id of the previous page.

post.summary: Submit a job (multipart upload or JSON rows).
Create refresh-negatives jobs for due NoMatch keys (409 while one is active).

409.description: A refresh job is already active

get.summary: One job with progress and ETA.

delete.summary: Delete a job with its rows (cached answers stay).

post.summary: Pause a queued or running job (the chunk in flight finishes).

409.description: Not allowed in the job's state
Not allowed in the job's state

post.summary: Cancel a job; pending rows stay pending.

409.description: Not allowed in the job's state

get.summary: Rows joined with the current cache entries, as batch CSV or JSON lines.

parameters.name: only
parameters.description: `unmatched`: only rows that are not a Match.

get.summary: Entry counts, file size, hit ratio, retry queue, jobs and redb table statistics.

parameters.name: detail
parameters.description:
`full`: also scan every entry header for per-status/searchtype/benchmark counts
and sample the compression ratio (slower; the default is cheap enough to poll).

parameters.name: prefix
parameters.description: Key prefix (e.g. `v1|address|4|`); combined with nothing else.

get.summary: One decoded entry. Percent-encode the key (it contains `|`, `;`, spaces, maybe `/`).

post.summary:
Delete (or with `dry_run`, count) entries by scope. Per-entry hit counters and retry
queue items of purged keys are left in place (a refresh settles a missing entry).

get.summary: Stream entries as JSON lines (decoded; importable into any build).

parameters.name: prefix
parameters.description: Only keys starting with this prefix.

post.summary:
Restore exported JSON lines, or warm the cache from a CSV via a `warm` job. The body
is bounded by `server.max_body_mb`.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description:
`jsonl` (default): restore exported entries. `csv`: geocode the rows as a cache
warming job (`returntype`, `benchmark`, `vintage`, `searchtype` as for jobs).

post.summary: Reclaim free space (`Database::compact`). Reads and writes wait while it runs.

get.summary: Benchmarks and vintages in effect (with default layer lists).

post.summary: Refetch benchmarks and vintages from upstream (background priority).

get.summary: Effective configuration with the source of every value (secrets redacted).

put.summary:
Set runtime overrides (`{"throttle.single_rps": 2, "ttl.tie": "7d"}`), persisted and
applied immediately (the upstream limiter is rebuilt). Only the `cache`, `ttl`,
`retry`, `batch`, `jobs` and `throttle` sections can be overridden.

delete.summary: Remove one runtime override; the key falls back to its startup value.

get.summary: Limiter, in-flight requests, circuit breaker and recent upstream errors.

BatchView.description: Batch CSV fields for one row. Strings are kept exactly as upstream wrote them.

BreakerState.description: Snapshot of the breaker for health/admin endpoints.

retry_after_secs.description: Seconds until the breaker half-opens (0 when closed).

open_until.description: Unix seconds when it half-opens, if open.

hit_ratio.description: `hits / (hits + misses)`, when any request was counted.

sampled.description: Entries decoded for the sample (the first ones in key order).

stored_bytes.description: Stored envelope bytes of the sample.

raw_bytes.description: The same entries uncompressed (header + rmp payload).

Counts.description:
Row tallies. `total = matched + no_match + tie + pending + failed`; `cached` counts
the answered rows that came from the cache rather than this job's upstream calls.

json.description: The stored upstream JSON (`addressMatches` or `geographies`), verbatim.

next_cursor.description:
Pass back as `cursor`; absent at the end. It is the last key *examined*, so
filtered pages may be short (even empty) while it still advances.

expires_at.description: Unix seconds when it stops being fresh (absent: never expires).

records.description: Valid records restored (an existing newer entry is kept instead).

id.description: UUIDv7: ids sort by creation time.

vintage_id.description: The vintage in the cache keys (the benchmark default for `locations`).

priority.description: Higher runs first; ties run oldest first.

JobUpload.description: Multipart submission (documentation only; parsed by hand).

addressFile.description: `id, street, city, state, zip` (or `id, address` with `searchtype=onelineaddress`).

progress.description: Percent of rows answered or failed.

eta_secs.description: Estimated seconds left, from the upstream rate since the job started.

JsonRow.description:
`{id, street, city?, state?, zip?}`, `{id, x, y}` or `{id, address}`; ids and
coordinates may be strings or numbers.

sync_waiters.description: Live (`Sync`) callers queued for a permit.

value.description:
`benchmark`: id or name; `vintage`: `benchmark:vintage` (ids or names);
`status`: `Match`/`NoMatch`/`Tie`; `prefix`: the key prefix.

Source.description: Where the effective value of a key came from.

undecodable.description: Entries whose header cannot be read.

SubmitJson.description: JSON submission: one row shape per job.

singleflight_in_flight.description: Distinct upstream fetches currently coalescing live requests.

last_ok_at.description: Unix seconds of the last non-transient upstream answer.

default_layers.description: Layers returned when a request omits `layers` (absent: all stored layers).

tags.name: admin
tags.description: Catalog, runtime config and upstream state
